Resolves #21518

Start here now reads Workstation · the 100,000 × 200 grid · the tree grid at scale · **DevIndex** · the COVID app · GitHub Issues · Studio Bookings · Garden Plan · Sprint Board · Calendar · Web Desktop · **Dock Choreography**. Country Statistics Grid leaves the wall and stands 13th in the catalog, so the wall stays at twelve and its Grid & Table place holds. The DevIndex card points at `devindex-14.jpg`: the full-app frame at 1280 × 720, 142,652 bytes (neomjs/pages#140), in place of the 1.76 MB PNG.

Evidence: L3 (local Portal at 1440 px wide with the cover routed from the Pages PR's bytes; unit specs; `verify.mjs`) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4). AC-3's cover is on Pages `main`: neomjs/pages#140 merged at 21:48Z.
